title: Summoning demonstrations for the AARO director

tellings.quote: We're doing demonstrations for the new director of Arrow. They're fully privy. They've seen our videos.

plain: A private team says it has been showing the head of AARO, the Pentagon's current office for unexplained aerial reports, how it can summon unexplained craft. Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he takes part, tells Michels: "We're doing demonstrations for the new director," adding that the office is "fully privy" and has "seen our videos." If true, it would mean the government is watching the attempts first-hand.
